question: Related Questions Q. Bismillahirahmanir-raheem ,As-salamualikum.Respected Mufti Saheb.I have a query regarding the Kutba in Juma Namaz.I Live in Kuwait and a Masjid near my residence delivers the Kutba in Urdu. Several people who i know, but they are no alims, say that a Kutba in Juma Namaz has to be compulsorily in Arabic. When In India I have never heard a kutba in any other language. But here in Kuwait we get to hear in, Urdu, English, Malyalum,Filipino and many more languages. Please clear my doubt and shed some light on this issue. ether its allowed or not. Assalamualaykum, Basicllay am from Hyderabad India, and Iam a follower of Hanafi mazhab. Currently am residing in Saudi Arabia for Job The calarification which i need is as follows: Here in Saudi Arabia on Friday , Azaan is recited well in advance at around 10.45 am whereas Zohar time starts around 11.50, when we reach Masjid at around 11.30 i find all people praying sunnah, i find it difficult that wether i can also prey the Jumae sunnah at 11.30am whereas time starts only at 11.50am, if i do not prey at 11.30, Imam starts Qutab-e- Jumah at 11.45, hence my sunnah is getting lost. Please guide me what shall i do. 2228 views Q. Dear Mufti Sahib Assalam o Alikum! I am a researcher in a university in Pohang (a small city in south Korea). Here we have no local muslim community and masjid. Only few muslim students and scholars are present (from other countries) in the university (about 6 to 8). Some time even more or less because visiting scholars come here for a short time. Out of these muslims only 4 come for jumma prayer including me. My other three muslim friends (those who come for jumma prayer) offer jumma Khutba in English some even they say no word in Arabic except Bismillah. Please tell me if our Jumma prayer is valid under these circumstances or not. Some time there are only three persons for jumma prayer. My friends are of the view that jumma can be offered with three persons also. Please also tell me the minimum nember of persons required for validity of jumma prayer. This university is inside the city Pohang. Is Jumma compulsary here? One thing more I want to know is about the person who can lead jumma prayer. My friends have decided that jumma prayer will be lead by every one turn by turn. All other three friends of mine have no beard. They are very strict in their decision and do not want to even listen any body about it. I have told them that jumma prayer is valid only with Arabic Khutba and atleast with four persons but they are not ready to except it. Please tell me what should I do under these circumstances. Should I offer jumma with them or offer my Zuhar prayer alone. Jazakallah. Looking for an early reply in this regard. Wassalam Aman-ur-Rehman 2242 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 67707 Country: india Title: Where one should look while listening the khutba? Question: Where should I see during Jumuah khutbah? Should I look at the Khatib or see in my legs? Answer ID: 67707 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1130/1141/N=11/1437) One should face the imam during the Khutbah with listening carefully and should not look to one’s lap, it is mustahab. ويستحب للرجل أن يستقبل الخطيب بوجهه ، هذا إذا كان أمام الإمام ، فإن كان عن يمين الإمام أو عن يساره قريباً من الإمام ينحرف إلى الإمام مستعداً للسماع كذا فى الخلاصة (الفتاوى الهندية، كتاب الصلاة ، الباب السادس عشر في صلاة الجمعة 1: 147، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
